Intranasal fentanyl can increase the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of isavuconazonium sulfate by inhibiting the metabolism mediated by the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Similarly, isavuconazonium sulfate can enhance the levels or effects of intranasal fentanyl through the same mechanism. Clinical caution and monitoring are advised. 2. Isavuconazonium sulfate can elevate the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of fentanyl delivered via an iontophoretic transdermal system by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Clinical caution and monitoring are recommended. 3. Fentanyl administered transdermally can increase the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of isavuconazonium sulfate by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Conversely, isavuconazonium sulfate can enhance the levels or effects of transdermal fentanyl through the same mechanism. Clinical caution and monitoring are advised. 4.
